arxiv-2210-07606.title: Revisiting Heterophily For Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2210-07606.creator: Sitao Luan, Chenqing Hua, Qincheng Lu, Jiaqi Zhu, Mingde Zhao, Shuyuan Zhang, Xiao-Wen Chang, Doina Precup {sitao.luan@mail, chenqing.hua@mail, qincheng.lu@mail, jiaqi.zhu@mail, mingde.zhao@mail,shuyuan.zhang@mail, chang@cs, dprecup@cs}.mcgill.ca
arxiv-2210-07606.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) extend basic Neural Networks (NNs) by using graph structures based on the relational inductive bias (homophily assumption). While GNNs have been commonly believed to outperform NNs in real-world tasks, recent work has identified a non-trivial set of datasets where their performance compared to NNs is not satisfactory.

arxiv-2303-12788.title: Open-source Frame Semantic Parsing
arxiv-2303-12788.creator: David Chanin
arxiv-2303-12788.description: Abstract While the state-of-the-art for frame semantic parsing has progressed dramatically in recent years, it is still difficult for end-users to apply state-of-the-art models in practice. To address this, we present Frame Semantic Transformer, an open-source Python library which achieves near state-of-the-art performance on FrameNet 1.7, while focusing on ease-of-use.

arxiv-2311-06209.creator: F. Cullen, D. J. McLeod, R. J. McLure, J. S. Dunlop, C. T. Donnan, A. C. Carnall, L. C. Keating, D. Magee, K. Z. Arellano-Cordova, R. A. A. Bowler, R. Begley, S. R. Flury, M. L. Hamadouche, T. M. Stanton
arxiv-2311-06209.description: Abstract We present an analysis of the ultraviolet (UV) continuum slopes ( β \beta ) for a sample of 172 172 galaxy candidates at 8 < z phot < 16 8<z_{\mathrm{phot}}<16 selected from a combination of JWST NIRCam imaging and COSMOS/UltraVISTA ground-based near-infrared imaging.

arxiv-2312-02633.title: Density-Jump Transitions in the Debye-Hückel Theory of Spin Ice and Electrolytes
arxiv-2312-02633.creator: Omar J. Abbas, Steven T. Bramwell, Daan M. Arroo
arxiv-2312-02633.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Omar J. Abbas, Steven T. Bramwell, Daan M. Arroo. Debye-Hückel theory, originally developed to describe dilute electrolyte solutions, has proved particularly successful as a description of magnetic monopoles in spin ice systems such as Dy 2 Ti 2 O 7 . For this model, Ryzhkin et al. predicted a phase transition in which the monopole density abruptly changes by several orders of magnitude but to date this transition has not been observed experimentally.

arxiv-2502-20306.creator: Lingyu Du, Yupei Liu, Jinyuan Jia, Guohao Lan
arxiv-2502-20306.description: Abstract . Gaze estimation models are widely used in applications such as driver attention monitoring and human-computer interaction. While many methods for gaze estimation exist, they rely heavily on data-hungry deep learning to achieve high performance. This reliance often forces practitioners to harvest training data from unverified public datasets, outsource model training, or rely on pre-trained models.

They experience harsher conditions due to enhanced stellar magnetic activity and wind shaping the secular evolution of a planetary atmosphere. Aims. arxiv-2509-21823.title: ProRe : A Proactive Reward System for GUI Agents via Reasoner–Actor Collaboration
arxiv-2509-21823.creator: Gaole Dai, Shiqi Jiang, Ting Cao, Yuqing Yang, Yuanchun Li, Rui Tan, Mo Li, Lili Qiu
arxiv-2509-21823.description: Abstract Reward is critical to the evaluation and training of large language models (LLMs). However, existing rule-based or model-based reward methods struggle to generalize to GUI agents, where access to ground-truth trajectories or application databases is often unavailable, and static trajectory-based LLM-as-a-Judge approaches suffer from limited accuracy.

arxiv-2509-24510.title: Specialization after Generalization: Towards Understanding Test-Time Training in Foundation Models
arxiv-2509-24510.creator: Jonas Hübotter, Patrik Wolf, Alexander Shevchenko, [1pt] Dennis Jüni, Andreas Krause, Gil Kur
arxiv-2509-24510.description: Abstract Recent empirical studies have explored the idea of continuing to train a model at test-time for a given task, known as test-time training (TTT), and have found it to yield significant performance improvements. However, there is limited understanding of why and when TTT is effective.

arxiv-2605-18381.title: Generating Physically Consistent Molecules with Energy-Based Models
arxiv-2605-18381.creator: Christoph Griesbacher, Lea Bogensperger, Andreas Habring, Thomas Pock

pmc-10572288.title: Sociodemographic and Clinical Profile of Long COVID-19 Patients, and Its Correlation with Medical Leave: A Comprehensive Descriptive and Multicenter Study
pmc-10572288.creator: Esperanza Romero-Rodriguez, Luis Angel Perula-de Torres, Jaime Monserrat-Villatoro, Jesus Gonzalez-Lama, Ana Belen Carmona-Casado, Antonio Ranchal-Sanchez
pmc-10572288.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The persistent condition of COVID-19 is characterized by a wide range of symptoms that have had a significant impact on both the health status and occupational life of the population. In this observational and multicenter study, the relationship between the sociodemographic and clinical profile of Spanish patients diagnosed with long COVID, and the work-related disability resulting from this pathology was analyzed. The analysis included 689 responses.

pmc-10741990.title: Foot Bionics Research Based on Reindeer Hoof Attachment Mechanism and Macro/Microstructures
pmc-10741990.creator: Guoyu Li, Rui Zhang, Yexuan Luo, Yue Liu, Qiang Cao, Jiafeng Song
pmc-10741990.description: The attachment performances of mechanical feet are significant in improving the trafficability and mobility of robots on the extreme ground. In the future, frozen-ground robots can be used to replace human soldiers in scouting and deep space exploration. In this study, the influence factors on the attachment function of the bionic feet were analyzed.

pmc-11340112.title: IARS2 mutations lead to Leigh syndrome with a combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency
pmc-11340112.creator: Qiyu Dong, Xiaojie Yin, Shuanglong Fan, Sheng Zhong, Wenxin Yang, Keer Chen, Qian Wang, Xue Ma, Refiloe Laurentinah Mahlatsi, Yanling Yang, Jianxin Lyu, Hezhi Fang, Ya Wang
pmc-11340112.description: BackgroundLeigh syndrome (LS) is a common mitochondrial disease caused by mutations in both mitochondrial and nuclear genes. Isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase 2 (IARS2) encodes mitochondrial isoleucine-tRNA synthetase, and variants in IARS2 have been reported to cause LS. However, the pathogenic mechanism of IARS2 variants is still unclear.

pmc-11437119.title: Effect of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus IDCC 3201 on irritable bowel syndrome with constipation: a randomized, double-blind, and placebo-controlled trial
pmc-11437119.creator: Hyeji Kwon, Eoun Ho Nam, Hayoung Kim, Haneul Jo, Won Yeong Bang, Minjee Lee, Hyeonmin Shin, Dana Kim, Jeongho Kim, Hyejin Kim, Jongkyun Lee, Young Hoon Jung, Jungwoo Yang, Daeyoun David Won, Minhye Shin
pmc-11437119.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Irritable bowel syndrome is a chronic disorder affecting the gastrointestinal tract, negatively impacting patients’ quality of life. Here, we aimed to evaluate the effects of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus IDCC 3201 (RH 3201) on irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C). In this randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, a total of 30 subjects with IBS-C were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive 8 weeks of probiotics administration or placebo.

pmc-11475548.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Genomic and Expressed Repertoire of the T-Cell Receptor Beta Chain in Equus caballus
pmc-11475548.creator: Rachele Antonacci, Francesco Giannico, Roberta Moschetti, Angela Pala, Anna Caputi Jambrenghi, Serafina Massari
pmc-11475548.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryIn the mammalian immune system, αβ T lymphocytes are a fundamental set of T cells capable of recognizing an extraordinary range of antigens, presented in the context of the major histocompatibility complex molecules. The function of αβ T cells is linked to the T-cell receptor, a heterodimeric cell surface protein composed of an α and β chain uniquely expressed on T cells.

pmc-12852926.title: Impact of drought on global food security by 2050
pmc-12852926.creator: Vachel A Kraklow, Kirsten Paff, Darin Comeau, Kurt Solander, Travis R Pitts, Stephen F Price, Chonggang Xu
pmc-12852926.description: Drought is a major driver of crop production loss, threatening global food security as the population rises toward 9 billion by 2050. Using a process-based crop model within an Earth system model, we assess drought-related impacts on maize, soybean, rice, and wheat production at global and country levels.

pmc-13377282.title: Enhancing agreement in cardiotocography interpretation between midwives and obstetricians through a rule‐based AI program: A comparative cross‐sectional study
pmc-13377282.creator: Sriwipa Kaewsrinual, Nutta Homdee, Thanapa Rekhawasin Pinnington, Supitchaya Surasereewong, Pharuhas Chanprapaph
pmc-13377282.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate whether a rule‐based artificial intelligence (AI) program can enhance interrater agreement in cardiotocography (CTG) interpretation between nurse–midwives and obstetricians.MethodsCTG data from 50 singleton pregnancies at ≥32 weeks of gestation were used to develop a rule‐based AI program based on National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) 2008 guidelines, with content validity confirmed (item–objective congruence = 0.85).

pmc-13591594.title: Across the United States: Wealth and Insurance Coverage as Predictors of Delayed Alveolar Bone Graft
pmc-13591594.creator: Hanna Pfershy, Jonathan Richard, Elizabeth Bushong, Darin Patmon, Ryan Badiee, Brooke Dudick, Anna Carlson, Jason Pomerantz, Gregory Fulton, John Girotto
pmc-13591594.description: surance status, institutional factors, and patient demographics effect a patient’s likelihood of receiving timely alveolar bone grafting. Methods: A retrospective analysis of all patients that received alveolar bone grafting was performed across three institutions. Demographic data, insurance status, driving distance, and median income was collected.

pmc-13625123.title: 3D Printable and Electrically Conductive Hyaluronic Acid Hydrogel for Cardiac and Vascular Tissue Engineering Applications
pmc-13625123.creator: Britanny L. Stark, Jose L. Perez, Edgar A. Borrego, Wilson Poon, Sylvia L. Natividad-Diaz
pmc-13625123.description: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of death worldwide. After acute myocardial infarction (AMI), the adult human heart has very limited regenerative capacities, and the electrical propagation of the myocardium is severely disrupted, which makes the patient more susceptible to heart failure and death.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2903.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2903 — Issuance of orders
uslaw-usc-t7-s2903.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2903.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 62 (Beef Research And Information). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) During the period beginning on January 1, 1986, and ending thirty days after receipt of a proposal for a beef promotion and research order, the Secretary shall publish such proposed order and give due notice and opportunity for public comment on such proposed order.
